note: What the teacher has told us about their own students (2026-11-16). This file is the only source for posts about students (🎓 Мои ученики, STRATEGY.md §3). A post may say what stands under `facts` for its group and nothing more: no names, ages, jobs, cities, levels, exam scores, results, quotes or lengths of time that are not here. The teacher spoke of groups (a few students), so a post never tells one person's story. Only the teacher adds to this file; a content run never does. facts: A few students live in the USA: they relocated there.
They need English to live a normal life there and to succeed in their business.
A few students relocated to Dubai.
They and the teacher have been working together for about 5 years.
They learn English because they love it, for the pleasure of it, not because they need it.
A few students are in Russia.
What interests them most is having conversations.
They look at English lessons as a kind of therapy.
A few students already have a fairly high level.
They keep studying because they understand that if they stop, the skill fades and their level drops.
